harbor-point-leasing

# Harbor Point — Leasing Notes Leasing status (October 2026): - Suite 120: Bluefin Coffee Roasters LLC — lease through 2029-05-31, renewal notice deadline 2028-08-31. - Suite 210: Copperline Fitness LLC — lease through 2027-11-30, renewal notice deadline 2027-05-31. The fitness tenant's renewal decision is the key 2027 event for this property. - Remaining retail suites are marketed at $28 per square foot.

harbor-point-overview

# Harbor Point — Overview Harbor Point is a mixed-use property at 88 Harbor Drive, Tampa, FL 33602, built in 2016. The ground floor holds retail suites; the upper floors are office space. Suite 120 is leased to Bluefin Coffee Roasters LLC, a specialty coffee retail and cafe tenant. Their lease commenced 2024-06-01 and runs through 2029-05-31, with base rent of $84,000 per year and 3% annual escalations.

ironworks-leasing

# Ironworks Industrial Park — Leasing Notes Leasing status (October 2026): - Building A (120,000 SF): Great Lakes Logistics Inc — lease through 2028-03-31, renewal notice deadline 2027-09-30. Base rent $210,000 per year with 3% annual escalations. - Buildings B and C are vacant and being marketed to distribution users.

ironworks-overview

# Ironworks Industrial Park — Overview Ironworks Industrial Park is an industrial property in Gary, IN, with 240,000 square feet across three buildings. The park is rail-served, with 18 dock doors and 24-foot clear heights. Current use is light manufacturing and distribution warehousing.

maple-grove-management

# Maple Grove Apartments — Management Notes On-site management notes (October 2026): - On-site manager: Dana Whitfield; maintenance lead: Priya Natarajan. - Average maintenance turnaround is 48 hours for non-emergency tickets. - Two shared laundry facilities, one per building cluster. - Surface parking: 180 spaces, unassigned. - Quarterly unit inspections; annual HVAC servicing each fall.

maple-grove-overview

# Maple Grove Apartments — Overview Maple Grove Apartments is a 120-unit garden-style multifamily property at 1420 Elm Street, Dayton, OH 45402, about ten minutes from downtown Dayton. Built in 1987 and renovated in 2019, the property offers a mix of 1BR, 2BR, and 3BR units. Occupancy was 94% at the time of the October 2026 offering memorandum, with an average rent of $1,160 per month.

portfolio-notes

# Portfolio Notes General notes across the fictional demo portfolio: - All three properties are fictional and used only for this demo. - Critical dates (lease expirations, renewal notice deadlines) are tracked per lease abstract; Harbor Point's Bluefin Coffee lease has a renewal notice deadline of 2028-08-31. - Quarterly property inspections are scheduled for all assets.
